name: core
description: v2.39.16 (2026-06-15) - D61 amendment: Flow fires via an INLINE block (literal text, like Input Routing), not a Skill invocation — a hook cannot force a Skill, so skill-every-turn was skipped on no-tool turns; the full core:flow Skill is the deep mode for substantive work. Marker-persistence fix: marker writes use the Write tool (Claude Code rolls back sandboxed Bash writes to .claude/). Operating system for building with AI. See CHANGELOG.md.
